errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis contains eight categories, but there are nine categories shown on the chart (程度, 空间, 时间, 形态, 频数, 情绪, 状态, 评价, 性格). The description later contradicts itself by listing all nine labels and stating there are nine bars.
The label on the x-axis is '情绪', but the description uses the traditional Chinese character '情緒'. While the meaning is the same, it does not match the character used in the figure.
